channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Troy university honors alumnus and trustee John Harrison
item.description: Dozens gathered at Trojan Arena to honor alumnus John Harrison and dedicate their practice facility to him.

item.title: Bitter Cold Air Lingers Into Early Monday
item.description: Another cold night ahead with temps plunging into the upper teens to lower 20s for lows.

item.title: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier leads two scoring drives as American beats National 17-9 in Senior Bowl
item.description: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier led a pair of touchdown drives, including a keeper for a score, as the American team beat the National team 17-9 in the Senior Bowl in Mobile today.

item.title: Demond Wilson, who played Lamont on TV’s “Sanford and Son,” dies at 79
item.description: Demond Wilson, who found fame in the 1970s playing Lamont on the hit TV comedy “Sanford and Son” and went on to become a minister, has died at 79.

item.title: Firefighters called to three fires in Montgomery
item.description: Montgomery Fire/Rescue units have battled three fires in less than 10 hours.

item.title: Auburn falls to Tennessee, 77-69
item.description: Auburn's four-game winning streak has come to an end.

item.title: Grass fire spreads to three buildings on Congressman Dickinson Drive in Montgomery
item.description: Montgomery Fire/Rescue units have battled a three-alarm fire in the 1800 block of Congressman Dickinson Drive.

item.title: No. 19 Florida beats No. 23 Alabama 100-77 after Todd Golden’s guarantee
item.description: The stat of the game: Alabama had 18 turnovers to Florida's two.

item.title: Montgomery staple featured in new documentary
item.description: Many people came out to the Capri Theatre in Montgomery to see a special viewing of a documentary about the famous Chris' Hot Dogs on Sunday.

item.title: Alabama Boys Foundation holds gala to raise money for literacy programs
item.description: Hundreds of people gathered at the RSA Activity Center for inaugural Alabama Boys Foundation fundraising gala
